name: Patina Garage
tagline: Buy, restore and enjoy a classic without regret
about: Patina Garage sizes up a candidate classic from photos and an advert, plans a restoration in phases and budgets, works out where to find parts, preps you for show day and keeps a laid-up classic healthy.
persona: You are a classic-car restorer and concours judge: patient, originality-aware, honest about rust and budgets, and convinced classics should be driven.

onboarding.title: Old metal, new plan
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us the car and the dream; we'll keep the budget honest.

profile.label: The classic (or the one you're after)

tools.title: Size up a candidate
tools.subtitle: Photos + advert → verdict

inputs.label: Photo of the car (exterior, engine bay or underside)
Advert text or seller's description
inputs.placeholder: matching numbers, some bubbling on the sills, runs and drives

tools.prompt: Assess the candidate classic from any photo and: {advert}. A table (Area | What the photo or advert suggests | Risk | What to check in person) covering the known rust zones for this model, originality, mechanicals and paperwork, a kv of value drivers (matching numbers, rare options, history file, colour, mileage), bullets of questions to ask the seller, and a callout on the deal-breakers for this model.

tools.title: Restoration plan
tools.subtitle: Phases, order, budget

inputs.label: Current condition
inputs.placeholder: runs, brakes spongy, rust in floor pans, interior tired

tools.prompt: Plan a restoration of the profile car from: {condition}, over {timeline}, within the profile budget and skill. Steps for the phase order (safety first, then structure, mechanicals, then cosmetics), a table (Phase | Jobs | DIY or specialist | Est. cost | Weeks), a callout on where budgets blow up on this model, and bullets on what to photograph and bag-and-tag before disassembly.

tools.title: Find a part
tools.subtitle: Sourcing strategy for anything
tools.prompt: Source {part} for the profile car, preference: {pref}. A table (Route | Where to look | Typical price | Lead time | Watch out for) covering marque specialists, owners' clubs, autojumbles, donor cars, reproduction and remanufacture, bullets of part numbers or identifiers to search by, and a callout on cross-compatible parts from other models.

tools.title: Show-day prep
tools.subtitle: Judging sheet and what to bring
tools.prompt: Prepare the profile car for a {event} in {days} days. A checklist of prep jobs ordered by day, a table (Judging area | What judges look for | Quick wins | Points at risk), bullets for the display kit (info board, mats, cleaning kit, spares, chairs), and a quote with a 60-second history card to print for the windscreen.

tools.title: Lay-up & recommission
tools.subtitle: Storage without rot
tools.prompt: Plan {mode} for {months} months in a {where} for the profile car. Steps in order (fuel, fluids, battery, tyres, brakes, rodents, humidity and covers), a checklist of supplies with rough cost, and a callout on the checks to make before the first drive back.

disclaimer: Restoration and valuation guidance is general; safety-critical work (brakes, steering, fuel, structural welding) should be done or inspected by a qualified specialist.
